messages:
emma: Received an inbound EUR bank transfer from ACME Corp for EUR 12,480.00 (value date 2025-09-12). No PO/invoice in the remittance; customer says ref should be INV-2025-1987/ACME. Created ticket ZD-3214 — can finance help reconcile?

jonas: On it. Do we have the MT103 or any SWIFT trace from the receiving bank? Customer forwarded a PDF note but it's unstructured.

emma: Bank support responded that an intermediary may have stripped the :70: (remittance) field due to truncation on the SWIFT chain. They only show beneficiary acct and amount on the credit advice.

priya: If the intermediary removed :70:, we'll need the sending bank or our correspondent to provide the full MT103 (or an MT199 trace). @jonas can you request via our bank rep or do you want me to draft the ask?

jonas: Please draft and cc treasury. Use this template: 

```
Subject: Request for copy of MT103 / payment trace
Dear [Bank Rep],
Please provide the full MT103 and any related MT199 trace for value date 12-Sep-2025, amount EUR 12,480, beneficiary: Redwood Inference, incoming reference: 20250912-ACME. Our client reference: INV-2025-1987/ACME.
We need the full populated fields (including :20:, :21:, :59:, :70:) to allow AR reconciliation and VAT matching.
Thank you,
Redwood Treasury
```

maya: :thumbsup: Sending to our rep now and asking the customer for the invoice PDF and their VAT reg. @emma do we have the VAT number on file? If not, we should mark as manual.

emma: Customer provided VAT GB123456789 and attached a scanned sender statement showing "BENEFICIARY: REDWOOD INFERENCE LTD - ACCT ****4321" and the value date. No invoice number on their bank copy.

priya: Good. When MT103 arrives check fields: :20: sender reference, :21: related reference, :59: beneficiary account, :70: remittance info. If :70: is empty we can still attempt match by amount + value date + sender name, but we'll need the invoice number for VAT posting. Flagging tax.

sasha: Tax here — if we can't get a structured remit we need either invoice number or payer VAT info for correct VAT treatment. If customer can't supply, mark as unapplied cash and hold VAT accounting until resolved. Please set AR hold to prevent misposting.

jonas: I'll create a manual allocation entry in AR with memo "INV-2025-1987 (manual)" and put the payment on hold. Updating ZD-3214 with actions; bank rep ETA 2-3 business days.

emma: Thanks. If the bank returns a truncated :70: we'll escalate and ask for an MT910/MT999 or a customer-signed remittance confirmation. :eyes:

priya: Noted — I'll follow up with the bank rep and paste any MT103/MT199 into the ticket. Will post updates here once received.
